bridge.text: Instagram refuses to sign in inside an app added to the home screen. The button below opens the sign-in in Safari.
bridge.hintIphone: if the Instagram app pops up instead of Safari and says "something went wrong", press and hold the button and pick "Open in New Tab" — iOS does not open the app on a long press. If that does not help, finish the connection on a computer; once is enough.
bridge.hintBack: Once the connection is done, switch back to Chrlit — the account verifies itself here.

return.failedBody: Instagram did not complete the authorisation. Go back to Chrlit and try Connect again; the account must be professional (Business or Creator).
